request.query: The index at a point of a product of two nonzero polynomials equals sum of their weighted indices

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R),
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g) = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g

items.name: Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {p q : Polynomial R} {x : R},
  p * q ≠ 0 → Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x (p * q) = Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x p + Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x q

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_prod
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type u_4} (w : σ → ℕ)
  (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : Finset ι),
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f i)

items.name: Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_mul'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {p q : Polynomial R} {x : R},
  Polynomial.eval x (p /ₘ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C x) ^ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x p) *
        Polynomial.eval x (q /ₘ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C x) ^ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x q) ≠
      0 →
    Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x (p * q) = Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x p + Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x q

items.name: Polynomial.degree_mul
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {p q : Polynomial R}, (p * q).degree = p.degree + q.degree
